versions.content: Avoid usage of Trailing underscores Type: Valid Description: Names shall not end with an underscore [_] character. Rationale: AUTOSAR tool such as RTE generates the name with the “_” to indicate the information flow path across the AR layer . This will facilitate the better understanding for tool generated names and also with limitation to number of characters in the name Use Case: -- Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: Naming Convention 1.0 from Powertrain Domain §2
